HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Tax classification note from Ada Auditor, CPA
Harbor Labs, LLC has two members and has made no election, so it is taxed as a
partnership by default. Form 8832 has not been filed.
No S corporation election has been made. An S election would rule out a fund as a
stockholder later.
The first partnership return, Form 1065, is due March 15, 2012 for the 2011 year.
On conversion to a Delaware corporation the company becomes a C corporation for tax
from that date.
